ShaderNodePreset.Description: Retro sci-fi HUD overlay. Inspired by Alien, Aliens, Blade Runner, 2001 A Space Odyssey, and TRON. Two-pass: pass 1 draws 13 animated HUD elements on a black background, pass 2 applies a CRT/old-TV filter.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_RetroHUD

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the radar element
Uniform.Name: radar_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Sweep arm rotation speed. Negative values reverse direction.
Uniform.Name: radar_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Starting angle of the sweep arm in degrees. 0 = right (3 o'clock), 90 = top (12 o'clock).
Uniform.Name: radar_sweep_start

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of random blip contacts shown on the radar screen. Blips glow brightly when the sweep arm passes over them and fade over the next 270 degrees.
Uniform.Name: radar_blips

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: radar_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the targeting reticle
Uniform.Name: reticle_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: reticle_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the oscilloscope display
Uniform.Name: oscope_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Sine wave 1 scroll speed. Also controls speed in Lissajous and Pulse modes.
Uniform.Name: oscope_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Sine wave 2 scroll speed. Only active in Sine mode.
Uniform.Name: oscope_speed2

Uniform.Tooltip: Shifts the animation start time for both waves
Uniform.Name: oscope_time_offset

Uniform.Tooltip: Trace waveform type: Sine = scrolling sine wave, Lissajous = XY phase figure, Pulse = square wave
Uniform.Name: oscope_mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Width of the oscilloscope screen — extends the frame and adds more grid columns
Uniform.Name: oscope_width

Uniform.Tooltip: Height of the oscilloscope screen — extends the frame and adds more grid rows
Uniform.Name: oscope_height

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: oscope_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the segmented bar meters
Uniform.Name: bars_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: bars_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the scrolling data terminal readout
Uniform.Name: terminal_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Text scroll speed. Negative values scroll downward.
Uniform.Name: terminal_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: terminal_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the receding wireframe perspective grid
Uniform.Name: pgrid_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Grid scroll speed — how fast cross lines advance toward the viewer
Uniform.Name: pgrid_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Horizon line vertical position. 0 = centre, 1 = top, -1 = bottom.
Uniform.Name: pgrid_horizon

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of lateral cells (columns) across the grid
Uniform.Name: pgrid_cols

Uniform.Tooltip: Spacing between cross lines — larger values push the rows farther apart in depth
Uniform.Name: pgrid_spacing

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: pgrid_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the tiling PCB circuit trace pattern
Uniform.Name: circuit_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse highlight travel speed along traces
Uniform.Name: circuit_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse density — how many flowing packets travel along the traces
Uniform.Name: circuit_pulse_density

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse size — length of each flowing packet along the trace
Uniform.Name: circuit_pulse_size

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse brightness — glow intensity of the flowing packets
Uniform.Name: circuit_pulse_bright

Uniform.Tooltip: Overall scale of the element. Larger values zoom in on the trace tile.
Uniform.Name: circuit_scale

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: circuit_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the corner bracket HUD frame
Uniform.Name: brackets_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse dot travel speed around the bracket perimeter
Uniform.Name: brackets_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Length of each bracket arm as a fraction of the frame edge
Uniform.Name: brackets_arm

Uniform.Tooltip: Scanner dot size — radius of the pulse tracing the frame perimeter
Uniform.Name: brackets_pulse_size

Uniform.Tooltip: Scanner dot brightness — glow intensity of the pulse (0 = off)
Uniform.Name: brackets_pulse_bright

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: brackets_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the horizontal compass heading tape
Uniform.Name: compass_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Vertical position in screen space — default near the top of frame
Uniform.Name: compass_pos_y

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: compass_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the trajectory arc with node markers
Uniform.Name: arc_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Travelling dot speed along the arc
Uniform.Name: arc_speed

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of node markers placed evenly along the arc
Uniform.Name: arc_nodes

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: arc_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the circular analog dial gauge
Uniform.Name: dial_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: dial_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the TRON-style light grid with pulsing nodes
Uniform.Name: lgrid_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse size — radius of the glowing intersection nodes
Uniform.Name: lgrid_pulse_size

Uniform.Tooltip: Pulse brightness — glow intensity of the nodes (0 = off)
Uniform.Name: lgrid_pulse_bright

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: lgrid_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Show or hide the TRON-style right-angle light trails
Uniform.Name: trail_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Trail length before it fades out (how far the trail extends behind the head)
Uniform.Name: trail_length

Uniform.Tooltip: Fade-off length at the tail. Short = abrupt cutoff; long (>= Trail Length) = fades over the whole trail
Uniform.Name: trail_fade

Uniform.Tooltip: Glow width — larger values give a softer, broader phosphor glow
Uniform.Name: trail_glow

Uniform.Tooltip: Give each lightcycle its own colour from the Cycle Colours column (off = all use Colour)
Uniform.Name: trail_multicolor

Uniform.Tooltip: Global animation speed multiplier. 1.0 = real time at 25 fps.
Uniform.Name: time_scale

Uniform.Tooltip: Shifts the global animation start point. Use to randomise or synchronise elements.
Uniform.Name: time_offset

Uniform.Tooltip: Enable or disable all screen geometry distortions
Uniform.Name: geo_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: CRT tube lens distortion. Positive = barrel (bulging), negative = pincushion (pinching).
Uniform.Name: geo_barrel

Uniform.Tooltip: Sinusoidal edge warp — simulates physical screen wobble or damaged CRT geometry
Uniform.Name: geo_edge_warp

Uniform.Tooltip: Top-left corner X offset for perspective pinning
Uniform.Name: geo_corner_tl_x

Uniform.Tooltip: Top-left corner Y offset for perspective pinning
Uniform.Name: geo_corner_tl_y

Uniform.Tooltip: Enable or disable the CRT scan line overlay
Uniform.Name: scanline_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of scan lines per screen height. Higher values give finer lines (higher resolution CRT look).
Uniform.Name: scanline_density

Uniform.Tooltip: How dark the scan line gaps are. 0 = invisible, 1 = fully black gaps.
Uniform.Name: scanline_intensity

Uniform.Tooltip: Interlaced mode alternates odd/even scan line fields each frame, simulating an interlaced CRT signal
Uniform.Name: scanline_interlace

Uniform.Tooltip: Enable or disable colour and glow effects
Uniform.Name: color_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: Radial RGB fringing that mimics a poorly-focused CRT electron gun
Uniform.Name: color_chroma_ab

Uniform.Tooltip: Phosphor bloom radius — soft glow from bright elements spreading onto neighbouring pixels
Uniform.Name: color_bloom

Uniform.Tooltip: Vignette darkening toward the screen edges, simulating CRT tube curvature
Uniform.Name: color_vignette

Uniform.Tooltip: Phosphor colour tint. 0 = neutral white, 1 = green P1 phosphor, 2 = amber P3 phosphor.
Uniform.Name: color_phosphor

Uniform.Tooltip: Contrast boost — lifts highlights and crushes shadows
Uniform.Name: color_contrast

Uniform.Tooltip: Enable or disable VHS and signal artefact effects
Uniform.Name: artifact_enable

Uniform.Tooltip: VHS tape dropout tears — random horizontal bands of shifted image
Uniform.Name: artifact_vhs_tears

Uniform.Tooltip: Chroma bleed — colour channels smear horizontally to the left, like a poorly-calibrated VHS deck
Uniform.Name: artifact_color_bleed

Uniform.Tooltip: Moire interference pattern from two slightly-offset sine grids beating against each other
Uniform.Name: artifact_moire

Uniform.Tooltip: Random static noise added to each pixel
Uniform.Name: artifact_static

Uniform.Tooltip: Vertical sync roll — the image scrolls vertically as if the V-sync lock has drifted. 0 = off.
Uniform.Name: artifact_sync_roll
